subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should this PR become the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106379 instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405?
rationale: Both open PRs now preserve source configuration while pruning startup assignments, but they use different implementation scopes and only one should land; current evidence favors this PR's narrower Gateway-owned boundary.

options.title: Adopt this PR
options.body: Rebase and land this narrower implementation, then close the competing PR as superseded.

options.title: Adopt the competing PR
options.body: Close this PR only if maintainers prefer the broader secrets fast-path changes in the competing implementation.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep both open only if maintainers want a third implementation shape or additional lifecycle proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR
recommendation.body: Rebase and land this narrower implementation, then close the competing PR as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the breaker behavior and its intended safe-mode contract, making them the strongest available owner for choosing the canonical implementation.
